summary: Fixed item-detail slow load (via.placeholder.com timeout), fixed try-on garment_image bug, rebuilt CatVTON Docker for true local inference, synced appData.items from API, improved outfit rating prompt, fixed outfit photo/edit.

item_sync.when: Awaited at start of DOMContentLoaded, before any rendering
item_sync.what: Fetches GET /api/items, normalizes image_url→image, saves to appData.items in localStorage
item_sync.why: All item lookups (outfit rendering, picker, edit, calendar, analytics, etc.) use appData.items.find(). Without sync, items uploaded via API are invisible to the frontend.

data_flow.outfits: Stored in localStorage (appData.outfits). Item references are integer IDs matching DB primary keys.
data_flow.api_items_have: id, name, description, category, price, brand, color, season, image_url, notes, wear_count, ai_analysis, tags
data_flow.appData_items_have: Same as API + image (normalized from image_url for backward compat with canvas/picker code)

ai_job_queue.description: Generic async job queue (from session 8). All AI ops go through POST/GET/DELETE /api/ai/jobs.

endpoints.POST /api/ai/jobs: Submit job by type, returns 202 + {id, status}

ai_job_queue.notification_panel: #ai-job-notifications, bottom-right, slide-in cards with cancel button

primary.status: RUNTIME_ERROR as of 2026-02-14. Unreliable — owned by third party.
primary.called_from: Go via uploadToGradio + callGradioTryOn in main.go

fallback.model_weights: Downloaded on first request into huggingface-cache Docker volume. ~5-8GB total (runwayml/stable-diffusion-inpainting, stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse, zhengchong/CatVTON).
fallback.first_run: Will download models then run inference. Very slow on first use (~10-15 min). Subsequent runs use cached weights (~5 min CPU inference with 20 steps).
fallback.status: Container rebuilt and running. Import test passes. Not yet tested end-to-end (model weights not yet downloaded).

recent_changes_this_session: Fixed item-detail.html slow load: replaced https://via.placeholder.com/400 (20s timeout) with empty src + CSS placeholder
Replaced all via.placeholder.com references in calendar.html and share.html with inline SVG data URIs
Fixed try-on garment_image bug: changed targetItem.image_url to targetItem.image || targetItem.image_url (canvas items use .image not .image_url)
Added syncItemsFromAPI() — fetches items from DB API, normalizes image_url→image, saves to appData.items
Made DOMContentLoaded handler async, awaits syncItemsFromAPI() before rendering
Reverted renderPickerItems back to sync (reads from appData.items which is now populated by sync)
Fixed outfit photos not showing on outfits page (items now in appData.items via sync)
Fixed outfit edit not loading items in outfit-builder (same root cause — appData.items was empty)
Improved rate-outfit prompt: includes item descriptions, forbids hallucinating garment features, forbids suggesting to remove items from outfit
Rebuilt CatVTON Docker container for true local inference (was using gradio_client wrapper to HF Space)
Cloned CatVTON repo locally to avoid Docker DNS issues, COPY into image instead of git clone
Removed xformers (CUDA-only) from requirements, switched to opencv-python-headless
Model weights download deferred to first request (cached in huggingface-cache Docker volume)

app.js.syncItemsFromAPI: Fetches /api/items, normalizes image_url→image, populates appData.items. Called at DOMContentLoaded start.
app.js.submitAIJob: Generic: POST /api/ai/jobs, creates notification, opens EventSource, returns Promise
app.js.handleTryOn: Gets person_image from canvas bg (SVG→PNG conversion), garment_image from targetItem.image||image_url, submits tryon job
app.js.renderPickerItems: Renders item picker from appData.items (now synced from API)
app.js.handleRateOutfit: Sends items with description/ai_analysis to rate-outfit job

main.go.runRateOutfitJob: Includes item descriptions in prompt, instructs model not to hallucinate features or suggest removing items
main.go.runTryOnJob: Tries HF Space → local Docker fallback

catvton/app.py.get_pipeline: Lazy-loads CatVTONPipeline from /app/catvton/model/pipeline.py, downloads weights on first call
catvton/app.py.try_on: POST /api/tryon — decodes base64 images, runs local inference, returns base64 result

catvton.note: Rebuilt for local inference. First request downloads ~5-8GB models.

known_issues.hf_space_down: zhengchong-catvton.hf.space is in RUNTIME_ERROR state. Cannot be fixed (not our Space). Consider duplicating to own HF account.
known_issues.catvton_first_run: First try-on request will download ~5-8GB of model weights. Very slow. Subsequent requests use cached weights from huggingface-cache volume.
known_issues.catvton_cpu_slow: Local CatVTON on CPU takes 5+ minutes per try-on with 20 inference steps.
known_issues.docker_dns: Docker builds may fail with DNS/connection issues. CatVTON repo is now cloned locally and COPY'd to avoid this.
known_issues.no_nvidia_gpu: User's machine has no NVIDIA GPU. CatVTON runs CPU-only PyTorch.
known_issues.svg_body_image: Default mannequin is SVG. Try-on converts SVG to PNG via canvas element.
known_issues.outfits_in_localstorage: Outfits are stored in localStorage, not in the DB. If localStorage is cleared, outfits are lost. Consider migrating to API/DB.

pending_work.catvton_e2e_test: CatVTON container rebuilt but model weights not yet downloaded. First try-on will trigger download. Needs end-to-end test.
pending_work.outfit_api: Outfits are still in localStorage. Should be migrated to a DB table with API endpoints for persistence.
pending_work.watermill_queue: User mentioned using watermill library with postgres for async job queue (for real backend).
pending_work.hf_space_alternative: Duplicate CatVTON Space to own HF account for reliable cloud try-on, or find a working fork.
